name: claude-code-ui-patch
description: Patch Claude Code with finegrained UI settings for font sizes, code blocks, diff cards, and more.

commands.title: Claude Code UI Patch: Restore Font Sizes
Claude Code UI Patch: Open Panel

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatCodeblockFontSize.markdownDescription: Chat panel code block size in px. Chat text stays native via `#chat.fontSize#`.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatDiffCardFontSize.markdownDescription: Diff card size in px (the side-by-side diff in Edit/MultiEdit tool cards, and its expanded modal).

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatDiffCardLineNumber.markdownDescription: Show line numbers in the diff card, with real `+`/`-` gutter signs and a de-emphasized first line. Line numbers count from the top of the shown change, not the file.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatDiffCardThemeSync.markdownDescription: Match the diff card theme to the current VS Code light/dark theme instead of the forced dark theme, updating live on theme change.

claudeCodeUiPatch.effortSyncFix.markdownDescription: The effort button shows the persisted level but the call could silently run at the CLI default. Set to true to ensure in-sync.

claudeCodeUiPatch.planPreviewFontSize.markdownDescription: Plan-preview rendered text size in px (headings scale with it).

claudeCodeUiPatch.planPreviewCodeblockFo.markdownDescription: Plan-preview code size in px (code blocks and inline code).

claudeCodeUiPatch.planPreviewCommentInpu.markdownDescription: Plan-preview select-and-comment input size in px.

claudeCodeUiPatch.planPreviewCommentQuot.markdownDescription: Plan-preview selected-text quote size in px.

claudeCodeUiPatch.planPreviewCommentBadg.markdownDescription: Plan-preview comment-count badge size in px (fixed 14px circle, keep <= 12).
